about_short_description.short_description: Multipool is a cutting-edge DEX transforming the trading landscape for RWAs and cryptocurrencies.

product.name: Fully Trustless On-Chain Order Book
product.description: An on-chain order book system that manages over 1 billion orders and cancellations per tick price, enhanced by dynamic bracket pools to improve market liquidity.

product.name: Global Real World Asset Marketplace
product.description: A decentralized marketplace enabling fully on-chain trading of real-world assets (RWAs) alongside cryptocurrencies.

product.name: P2P Repo Lending
product.description: A decentralized peer-to-peer lending service facilitating direct lending transactions without intermediaries.

product.name: Zero Price Impact Auctions
product.description: An auction mechanism designed to execute trades without causing price impact, ensuring optimal trade execution.

product.name: Trustless RFQs (Request for Quotes)
product.description: A decentralized protocol enabling transparent and secure quote requests for trades without intermediaries.

product.name: MEV Bot Protection
product.description: A feature that protects trades from front-running and other malicious Miner Extractable Value (MEV) activities.
